data_migrations: Your collection can no longer be brought up to date from a version before 0.7.0. If you last opened it with 0.6.0 or earlier, this version won't open it: the startup screen names the release to open it with first (0.9.2 for a collection last opened by 0.4.0 to 0.6.0), and offers to back it up and start fresh. Collections last opened by 0.7.0 or later are not affected.
changed: Version 0.7.0 now says, when it checks for updates, that its support ends on November 30, 2026, and asks you to update before then. Versions before 0.7.0 can't show this notice; they are already retired.

removed: Retire on-disk schema versions v35–v38: `kMinSupportedSchemaVersion` is now 39, the schema `v0.7.0-beta` shipped. Their upgrade steps, schema dumps, generated schema classes and the v35 and v38 release fixtures are deleted; the floor fixture is now `v39.sqlite`, captured from `v0.7.0-beta`.
